name: Peter Abelard publishes Sic et Non
summary: Peter Abelard's Sic et Non ('Yes and No') juxtaposes 158 contradictory patristic opinions on theological questions, inviting the reader to resolve the apparent contradictions by dialectical reasoning. The work becomes a paradigmatic model of the scholastic quaestio method.

_quarry.structural_significance: Foundational text of the scholastic method that defines 12th and 13th-century university learning; the quaestio-disputata structure of Aquinas's Summa is its direct intellectual descendant.
